rendered: The NiTi wires were strained axially in tension to 5% and 10%[1]. The text says the applied strains were maintained after unloading by the shape-memory effect of the NiTi alloy, which locked the strain into the surface V2O5 film. The overall tensile range mentioned for locking in elastic strains was 0−10%[2]. For the electrochemical samples, the wires were strained at 2 mm/min[3] on an Instron 5944[4] system, up to 5%[5] and 10%[6] strains.
